condition.narrative: Should contribute directly to results for children as outlined in the UNDAF, national results and/or UNICEF Strategic Plan and within the scope defined in the CPD, CPAP, OMP or other agreed upon programme documents

title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF advanced transformative innovations: a total of 389,869 learners accessed education via digital platforms, while over 310,000 children and young people engaged in UNICEF-supported initiatives, such as U-Report, climate action, online courses, and civic engagement programmes. Advocacy efforts led to the development of two adolescent-responsive policies, three strategies, and five guidelines, strengthening national systems. UNICEF supported he formulation of the National Disability Policy to support child rights. Key achievements in gender include a gender review of Kenya’s social and child protection systems, resulting in advocacy briefs for state and non-state actors. Over 50 partner focal persons have been trained on PSEA capacity assessments and action plan monitoring.
